{{Quote|This is a courtesy message to inform you that the postings to this topic are being monitored by G. Bresch, Lieutenant, Cularin Militia. The Militia appreciates your continued vigilance.|culmil1, posting on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="everyone's a critic" />}}
An individual who served the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] used the ID '''culmil1''' when posting on the [[Cularin holonet node]]. Following the circulation<ref name="everyone's a critic" /> on the Cularin holonet<ref name="the best defense">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310b|text=The Best Defense}}</ref> of a story in which a [[Thaereian military]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Nightwing]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Gender/Legends|his]] superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Kulkis]], many people theorized that the tale had been written by [[Osten Dal'Nay]],<ref name="everyone's a critic" /> a Thaereian military defector and a founding member of the Cularin Militia.<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050721ostendalnay|text=Osten Dal'Nay}}</ref> On behalf of the Cularin Militia, culmil1 posted on a Cularin holonet node thread speculating on the story to advise that [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[G. Bresch]] of the Cularin Militia was monitoring their discussion.<ref name="everyone's a critic" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cularin holonet node user culmil1 was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and was mentioned in the [[Wizards.com]] article ''[[Everyone's a Critic (article)|Everyone's a Critic]]'', a tie-in to [[RPGA]]'s ''[[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]]'' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] campaign. The article takes the form of a set of posts on the Cularin holonet node discussing the story about Nightwing and Kulkis, one of which is a message from culmil1. The article does not confirm whether culmil1 is a handle used by G. Bresch, the Cularin Militia lieutenant referred to in culmil1's post, or whether, alternatively, culmil1 is a separate individual.<ref name="everyone's a critic" />
